description: Search US customs bill of lading records by company name for importers and overseas suppliers. Returns shipment counts and last shipment dates. Set include_profiles to add trading partners, HS codes, product descriptions, and recent shipments, up to 20 a run. The search matches company names, not products.

company_urls.description: ImportYeti company or supplier links to read in full, up to 20 a run.

date_from.description: Optional, YYYY-MM-DD. Drops companies whose last shipment is older.

include_profiles.description: true adds trading partners, their countries, HS codes, product descriptions, and recent shipments to the first rows, up to Maximum profiles. Priced as a profile row.

max_charge_usd.description: Optional. The run stops before a charge that would pass this amount. Summary rows are always returned.

max_profiles.description: Up to 20, because the site limits page views per address and this actor stops there. Each profile adds about 7 seconds.

max_results.description: Up to 1000. Default 100. The site served about 140 rows per term in testing, so a broad term can stop sooner.

min_shipments.description: Optional. Drops companies with fewer shipments in total.

mode.description: importers: US companies importing. suppliers: overseas companies shipping to the US. both: either.

search.description: Company name words, for example pickleball or walmart. The site matches company names, not what a company imports. Up to 50 terms.

name: find_us_importers
title: Find US importers and suppliers
